probe.name: wC2_self_join_propagated
probe.sql: SELECT bs."in.comstock_building_type" AS comstock_building_type, sum(1) AS sample_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_national_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND (bs.bldg_id, bs."in.state") IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs."in.state" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_national_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1) AND bs.applicability = true AND bs."in.state" = 'CO' GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs."in.state" HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade)) = 1) AND bs."in.state" = 'CO' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
